maddeler.e:
نتعاطى (form VI)
# نَتَعَاطَى (nataʕāṭā) /na.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# نُتَعَاطَى (nutaʕāṭā) /nu.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
